answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, nodes register hardware-rooted identities by committing SGX attestation quotes to the saffron state tree, where an opal verification circuit evaluates enclave signatures against a cipher hash anchor. To forge identities, adversaries must physically provision unique silicon chips to generate valid quote roots; simultaneously, identity issuance requires quadratic bonding O(N²) staked collateral that undergoes irreversible slashing on duplicate keys.
